workload.image_description: deterministic white background with a filled red square at [112,112,335,335]
workload.eos_masking: EOS is masked before argmax for decode steps 1 through 14; step 15 may emit EOS

timing.preprocess: host monotonic wall clock from chat template and processor call through CUDA transfer, FP16 pixel-values cast, and synchronize
timing.vision_encoder: PyTorch: CUDA event duration around model.model.visual minus measured projector module durations. TensorRT: UNKNOWN because the frozen engine does not expose an internal boundary
timing.projector: PyTorch: sum of CUDA event durations around visual.merger and the three visual.deepstack_merger_list modules. TensorRT: UNKNOWN because the frozen engine does not expose an internal boundary
timing.visual_projector_combined: TensorRT: CUDA event duration around the unchanged visual adapter
timing.llm_prefill: CUDA event duration around the complete model forward on the full image-plus-text input
timing.decode: host monotonic wall clock around the 15 subsequent cached decode calls after synchronize
timing.decode_per_token: decode wall-clock latency divided by 15 subsequent decode calls
timing.event_synchronization: synchronize before prefill, after prefill, and after the decode loop
timing.hook_attribution: PyTorch visual and projector durations are measured by temporary forward hooks; hooks are removed before TensorRT backend runs

attribution_boundary.prefill_includes: vision backend, projector, embedding, language decoder, final norm, and LM head
attribution_boundary.derived_language_decoder_prefill: llm_prefill minus visual_total; derived, not independently isolated

acceptance.conclusion: record bounded stage latency attribution only
